summary: Bandai Namco's Summon Night series mixes tactical RPG systems, visual-novel-style character scenes, and action-RPG spin-offs across PlayStation, handheld, and GBA-era releases.

entries.title: Summon Night

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution and PGXP if stable.

primary.why: The original PlayStation version is the highest-fidelity route when upscaled in DuckStation, while the DS remake is a lower-resolution handheld remake with no sourced exclusive story route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation release in DuckStation with internal resolution upscaling, PGXP where stable, and the original disc image. Use the DS remake only if its handheld interface is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: The DS remake is an alternate remake rather than a clear definitive edition.

entries.title: Summon Night 2

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution and PGXP if stable.

primary.why: The PlayStation original remains the best high-resolution capture route; the DS remake is a handheld remake without a sourced exclusive-story reason to override the original.

entries.remaster_caveats: The DS remake is an alternate remake rather than a clear definitive edition.

emulation.notes: Use integer scaling and optional color correction.

primary.why: The GBA release is the only documented release and includes the localized North American version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GBA version in mGBA with integer scaling and a color-correction profile to taste.

entries.title: Summon Night 3
entries.definitive_edition: PS2 main run plus PSP additions check

emulation.notes: PCSX2 for the main run; PPSSPP for PSP-exclusive additions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Upscaled PS2 for primary, upscaled PSP for added content.

primary.why: PCSX2 gives the PS2 original the highest-resolution presentation, while the PSP remake adds documented extra systems and content that should be checked separately.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS2 release in PCSX2 with high internal resolution and widescreen if stable. Then sample the PSP remake for the added guest characters, Summon Assist, extra illustrations, special attacks, and gallery features.

secondary.exclusive_content: PSP remake additions including guest characters, Summon Assist, extra event illustrations, additional special attacks, and gallery mode.
secondary.what_to_play: Play or review the PSP remake content after the PS2 main run.
secondary.why: There are PSP-specific additions for Summon Night 3 and 4.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PSP remake is content-enhanced but limited by PSP resolution and interface.
